$comment: Generated by scripts/generate-effects.mts. Machine-readable description of every generated effect class.

props.name: blurType
props.description: Blur Type

props.name: strength
props.description: The intensity of the blur. 0 = no blur. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of a Motion blur, in degrees.

props.name: sigmaColor
props.description: Sigma value for color space in Bilateral / Edge-preserving blurs. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: centerX
props.description: The X coordinate of the blur center (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: centerY
props.description: The Y coordinate of the blur center (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: partialBlur
props.description: Blurs only a specific circular area around center point.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the partial blur region (0.01 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: radiusY
props.description: Vertical radius of the partial blur region (0 to 1.0). 0 reuses the horizontal radius.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the partial blur region.

props.name: keyColor
props.description: Key Color

props.name: similarity
props.description: How close the color must be to the Key Color to be removed.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: The softness of the transparency edge.

props.name: spillSuppression
props.description: Amount of key color spill to remove from foreground edges.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space used to calculate similarity distance.

props.name: spillSuppressionType
props.description: How key color spill is suppressed on foreground edges.

props.name: strength
props.description: The intensity of the vignette darkening effect. 0 = no vignette.

props.name: radius
props.description: The extent/size of the vignette.

props.name: softness
props.description: The softness of the vignette transition edge.

props.name: roundness
props.description: 0.0 matches the image aspect ratio, 1.0 is a perfect circle.

props.name: centerX
props.description: The X coordinate of the vignette center.

props.name: centerY
props.description: The Y coordinate of the vignette center.
